name: R01 findNestedFrontMatterValueLines: the front matter is read again for every line
why: a re-read of the whole front matter per line: answers identical, cost lines x text; clock only

name: R02 findNestedFrontMatterValueLines: the index is rebuilt every 256th line
why: the index rebuilt every 256th line: 136 ms at 20,000 lines (under the 1 s limit, so the 20,000-line rows pass), 1,435 ms at 80,000, 5,496 ms at 160,000 (HEAD 57 / 164 / 290): only the 100,000-line row sees it

name: R03 findNestedFrontMatterValueLines: the enumeration stops after 10,000 lines
why: the fast wrong answer: a cap on the walk. Only the rows with a nested engine AFTER the scalar can see it (the item's own row, with no tail, answers markdown either way)

name: R04 nearestShallowerLine: the index answers only for the first 1,024 lines
why: every line past 1,024 falls back to the scan past its siblings: same answers, clock only

name: R05 nearestShallowerLine: the index answers only for the first 19,900 lines
why: a cap on the index at 19,900 lines (a cap C is seen only by a document of about 1.2 C lines: 4,101 ms at 24,000, 11,081 ms at 30,000): the 20,000-line rows pass, the 100,000-line row sees every cap up to about 80,000

name: R06 indexLineIndents: the stack is never popped, the nearest shallower line is found by walking down it
why: the index builder made quadratic with typed-array steps only (the stack is never popped, the nearest shallower line is found by walking down it): 211 ms at 20,000 lines (under the 1 s limit), 2,589 ms at 80,000, 10,121 ms at 160,000 (HEAD 57 / 164 / 290): only the 100,000-line row sees it

name: R07 nestedParentPath: the first nearestShallowerLine call drops the index
from: const parentLine = nearestShallowerLine(lines, line, indent, index);
why: P01 by another door: the container of every line is scanned for; the chains are still used

name: R08 midDocumentMetadataBlocks: a stray question about line 0 before each real one
why: line 0 is before the position read to: the reader starts again from the top and the real question reads to its line again; commentOpenAt(0) is always false, so no answer moves

name: R09 midDocumentMetadataBlocks: the regions are walked last first
why: every question is before the one last asked: a rescan each; the 12,000 blocks are the same text, so the answer is the same

name: R10 midDocumentMetadataBlocks: the body is cut from a copy of the rest of the document
why: a copy of the rest of the document for each block: 663 ms at 12,000 groups in a fresh process at a load of 11 (HEAD 182 ms), so the 12,000-group rows kill it only on a loaded machine; 2,104 ms at 24,000 groups (HEAD 304 ms), so the 24,000-group row kills it on any

name: R11 htmlCommentOpenAt: starts again unless the line asked is the line last read to
why: == for < : every forward question reads from the top; resetting is always safe so no answer moves

name: R12 htmlCommentOpenAt: starts again after a jump of more than 3 lines
why: the groups' blocks are 4 lines apart

name: R13 htmlCommentOpenAt: every question is read to the end of the document
why: the first question reads everything; each later one is before that position and reads everything again; no comment in the rows so no answer moves

name: R14 governingMetadataContent: a selecting block governs as an empty block
why: the one path by which a mid-document block moves an answer: the reader unresolved, the group rows lose the gfm setext headings
